name: mcp-apps-browser-bridge
description: Generic companion for terminal MCP hosts (Claude Code CLI, etc.) that do not render MCP Apps ui:// resources. Wraps any stdio MCP server; when a tool result carries a ui:// resource, lazily opens a real browser tab that renders it via the official @modelcontextprotocol/ext-apps AppBridge, fully wired back to the same server.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.browser.json && vite build
